title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.18734v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by compressing the knowledge of a teacher LLM to train smaller LLMs. On-policy distillation advances this approach by having the student sample its own trajectories while a teacher LLM provides dense token-level supervision, addressing the distribution mismatch between training and inference in off-policy distillation methods. However, on-policy distillation typically requires a separate, often larger, teacher LLM and does not explicitly leverage ground-truth solutions available in reasoning datasets. Inspired by the intuition that a sufficiently capable LLM can rationalize external privileged reasoning traces and teach its weaker self, we introduce On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a learning algorithm where a single LLM acts as both teacher and student with different contexts. translated_title: 自蒸馏推理器：面向大语言模型的同策略自蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏通过压缩教师大语言模型（LLM）的知识来训练更小的LLM，从而提升其推理能力。同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）进一步推进了这一方法：由学生模型采样自身的轨迹，同时教师LLM提供密集的词元级监督，从而解决了离策略蒸馏方法中训练与推理之间的分布不匹配问题。然而，同策略蒸馏通常需要一个独立的、往往规模更大的教师LLM，并且没有显式利用推理数据集中已有的标准答案。受到一个直觉的启发——即足够强大的LLM能够对外部特权推理轨迹进行合理化解释并教会较弱的自身——我们提出了同策略自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD），这是一种让单个LLM在不同上下文中同时充当教师与学生的学习算法。教师策略以特权信息（例如经过验证的推理轨迹）为条件进行指导……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）学习算法，让单个LLM在不同上下文中同时充当教师与学生——教师以特权信息（如经过验证的推理轨迹）为条件对学生进行密集监督，从而无需独立的教师模型，并显式利用了推理数据集中的标准答案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a learning algorithm where a single LLM serves as both teacher and student in different contexts, with the teacher conditioning on privileged information (e.g., verified reasoning traces) to provide dense supervision—eliminating the need for a separate teacher model while explicitly leveraging ground-truth solutions from reasoning datasets.
